title: Fixed-size sliding window
summary: Find the largest sum of exactly k consecutive values. Update the sum by adding the entering value and subtracting the leaving value.
code: total = sum(values[i] for i in range(k))
triggers: best total over exactly k consecutive items
neighboring windows differ by one item at each end
prompts: Find the busiest stretch of exactly seven days in a list of daily totals.
Find the best net return over a fixed number of consecutive trades, including losses.
invariant: Each candidate total covers exactly k items ending at the current index.
mantra: Add the entrant, subtract the item k steps back.
pitfalls: Initialize best from the first full window so all-negative values are handled.

anchors.name: Maximum Average Subarray I
anchors.trick: Maximize the fixed-length sum before dividing by k.

mutations.explanation: Invents a zero-sum candidate for an all-negative input.
